$comment: Declared state of every VoxTable voice line — the machine-readable SSOT for the routing
chain. NUMBERS.md narrates this file; where they disagree, THIS file is what the checker
enforces and NUMBERS.md is the one that is stale.
Why it exists: the line is four bindings in four systems (Twilio trunk, Retell number
import, Retell agent, the restaurants row). Nothing referenced the others, so a binding
could vanish and only a human placing a call would find out. On 20 Aug 2026 three of the
four were broken at once on production and had been for a day.
Identifiers only. NEVER put an auth token, API key or webhook secret in here (NUMBERS.md §7).
Update this file in the SAME change as the vendor mutation, never afterwards.

$routing_comment: Read back from Twilio, the Serverless API and Retell on 6 Sep 2026: this number is NOT on a SIP
trunk. Since 30 Aug 2026 its voice_url points at the Twilio Function router owned by the
sibling repo ~/voxstay (docs/number-routing.md there), which is how one paid test number is
shared between VoxTable staging, the VoxStay hotel agent and any other experiment. Which
agent answers is the router Variable ACTIVE_APP_61468203234 (falling back to the global
ACTIVE_APP), switched by hand with voxstay's twilio-route.py — or from this repo with
switch-line.mjs, which drives that CLI and then re-asserts the whole chain.
There is deliberately NO declared holder here. Sam switches the number several times a day;
a declared holder would turn the scheduled check red after every switch until a commit landed.
assert-line reads the live holder, prints it as HOLDER: <profile>, and asserts that the live
state is COHERENT with that profile (router target, desk, Retell mode). `--expect <profile>`
adds the equality check for a human who needs to know before dialling.
profiles.<slug>.retell: 'webhook' = the Retell number stays in webhook mode and /retell/inbound
picks the agent; 'untouched' = Retell never sees the call (router sends it to an https target);
'static' = Retell inbound_agents pinned to profiles.<slug>.retell_agent_id with the webhook
cleared, for any other Retell agent that must share this number (it must live in the Staging
workspace — a number lives in exactly one workspace, skill rule 7).
The AU1 trunk TKdebe2aa1a4287ca4b2f22da0e9d10ed7 (voxtable-staging-au1) this entry used to
declare has carried no number since 30 Aug and is inert. Checks [15]-[20] read it as a ghost
record until 6 Sep 2026 and passed while three real calls failed (SIP 487, Retell never
answered). The 'revert staging to tls + secure=true' decision is therefore closed as moot.
The Retell number object still names that trunk in sip_outbound_trunk_config.termination_uri —
outbound only, never used, recorded here rather than 'fixed'.

$trunk_posture_comment: Read back from the trunk at build time, 27 Aug 2026 — not the recipe. Built US1 + tls +
secure=true deliberately: AU1 drops calls on BOTH tls and tcp, US1+tcp is clean over 25

and the trunk to secure=false) — only REGION is immutable after creation.
